## Jira GET with pagination + rate-limit handling
Called by the monitor once per request. 2xx: keep the page and fetch the next (startAt/isLast or nextPageToken). 429/503 or any Retry-After / X-RateLimit-Reset header: wait exactly that long. 408/425/5xx/network errors: exponential backoff with jitter (Config.jiraRetryBaseDelayMs x 2^attempt, capped at jiraRetryMaxDelayMs, up to jiraMaxRetries). Other 4xx: fail at once. Logic: src/jira-paging.js
